content.what_it_is: Interactive MATLAB animation script for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel_island_beach case: builds an AVI movie of surface elevation over the frame range the user types in. It loads eta_00001 into a variable named mask (unused later, L6), prompts for start/end snapshot numbers ns/ne via input() (L8-L9), loads depth.txt from fdep='' i.e. the current directory (L4, L11) and sizes the grid from it (L15; commented fixed sizes n=3600/m=3200 at L13-L14), builds x,y from origin 0.0 with spacing dx=2.0 — y uses dx as well (L16-L21). It opens VideoWriter movie.avi at 10 fps (L31-L33) and a 6x6-inch figure (L35-L40). Per frame num=ns:ne (L44): loads eta_<fnum> (L46-L47), sets eta>10.0 to NaN (dry-cell sentinel filter, L50), draws pcolor(x,y,eta) with interp shading and caxis [-0.5 0.5] (L56-L57), labels axes (L59-L60; the time title is commented out at L62-L63), pauses, captures the frame and writes it (L65-L68). Closes the video at L72.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
fdep — depth file directory, empty string (L4)
mask — array loaded from eta_00001, never used after load (L6)
n, m — grid dimensions from size(dep1) (L15)

equations.ref: filtering dry/land sentinel values above 10 m before plotting
y coordinates built with dx (no separate dy)

io.name: per-frame pcolor of eta with caxis [-0.5 0.5]

unresolved: The variable mask is loaded from eta_00001 (L6) but never used; the name suggests a leftover from a mask-based version.
No dy is defined; y uses dx (L21), correct only because the case grid is square (dx=dy=2.0 per mk_depth.m) — a latent bug if the case changes.
The eta>10.0 NaN filter (L50) implies dry cells carry large sentinel values in this output; the exact sentinel convention is not documented here.
The commented title (L62-L63) suggests a 2.5 s output interval; unverifiable from this file.
depth.txt is read from the script's working directory (fdep='', L4, L11) while eta comes from output/ — the run layout must place depth.txt beside the script.
